data.comment:
# Comfy Vidu Q2- Image to Video

Transform static images into dynamic 1080p videos with cinematic camera control, multi-subject consistency Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_vidu_q2_i2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: The bear takes a slow, appreciative sip from the steaming mug. Thick, realistic steam rises from the cup and curls around its nose. The bear closes its eyes in contentment, and its fuzzy ears twitch slightly. The texture of the knitted sweater is highly detailed as it moves with the bear's breathing.
